 It is my privilege to present the best ever quarterly performance in HFCL’s history that marks 
a defining moment in our growth journey. These results reflect the increasing scale, strength 
and momentum of our business and reinforce our confidence in HFCL’s ability to deliver 
sustained growth and create enduring value for our stakeholders. 
Let me begin with our outstanding performance for the second quarter and first half of FY27. 
Both profit before tax and profit after tax grew more than fivefold over the same period last 
year. Consolidated profit before tax in Q2 FY27 reached ₹538.60 crore as compared to ₹106.34 
crore in Q2 FY26, rising 406.49% year-on-year and 62.46% quarter-on-quarter. Consolidated 
profit after tax in Q2 FY27 rose to ₹394.22 crore, as compared to ₹71.92 crore in Q2 FY26, an 
increase of 448.14% year-on-year and 60.49% quarter-on-quarter. On half yearly basis the PBT

grew from ₹61.64 crore to ₹870.12 crore, up by 1311.62% while PAT grew from ₹42.62 crore

Consolidated revenue surged to ₹2,541.79 crore, increasing by approximately 143.62% year-
on-year and by 32.73% over the previous quarter. EBITDA increased to ₹658.00 crore, 
delivering growth of 223.55% year-on-year and 47.78% quarter-on-quarter. Equally 
significant, EBITDA margin expanded to 25.89%, improving by 640 basis points year-on-year 
and 264 basis points quarter-on-quarter, while PAT margin rose to 15.51%, gaining 862 basis 
points year-on-year and 268 basis points over the previous quarter. Together, these numbers 
demonstrate the strength of our operating model and ability to translate rapid growth into 
substantially higher profitability. 
The momentum we are witnessing today reflects the strategic initiatives taken and investments 
made by the Company. We invested ahead of the curve in capabilities, capacity enhancement, 
backward integration, development of world-class technology products and global market 
access with a clear focus on building a stronger and more scalable business. These initiatives 
are now translating into meaningful business growth, which is also reflected in our export 
performance, representing a growth of approximately 493% year-on-year. 
More significantly, the growing business visibility across these strategic initiatives gives us 
strong confidence in the journey ahead. I want to assure you that HFCL is on track to maintain 
its growth trajectory of revenue and profitability ahead. Our focus is on sustaining the pace of 
execution and translating the opportunity into continued strong performance. 
Our order book stands at ₹28,900 crore, providing multi-year revenue visibility. Beyond this 
secured business, we also have a strong pipeline of orders at advanced stages likely to be 
converted into firm contracts in due course. Friends, I want to emphasise that we do not see this 
quarter as a peak, but as the sustained phase of strong growth. Our confidence rests on a robust 
order book, a strong pipeline and long term customer programmes. Our customers include 
some of the World’s largest, financially strong technology companies, with demand anchored 
in long-term agreements and firm commitments. As the pipeline converts into orders, we 
expect our order book to strengthen further. These relationships, together with our capacity 
expansion and growing share of advanced optical connectivity products, give us strong 
visibility and confidence in sustaining—and building on—the current revenue and profitability 
trajectory. 
Demand continues to accelerate across AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centres and telecom 
networks. Encouragingly, opportunities with hyperscalers and telecom operators across 
international markets are steadily converting into firm contracts, strengthening our order 
pipeline and providing revenue visibility for long term. Our sustained investments in 
technology, customer relationships and manufacturing capacity position HFCL strongly to 
capture this long-term growth opportunity. 
Friends, you will recall that we began FY27 with a revenue growth aspiration of approximately 
20% over FY26. After the first quarter, we revised it to 40%, and today when I present

of growth. We are very excited by the long-term opportunity in this business. Years of 
investment in indigenous technology, product development and qualification have created a 
platform that we are now translating into orders and deliveries.

acquisition during the current quarter. Importantly, the aerospace business being acquired 
already has unexecuted order book of approximately ₹1600 crore, providing good visibility 
from the outset. At the same time, our ambitions in this sector extend well beyond this 
acquisition, and we are actively working on several other large opportunities. We remain on 
track towards our aspiration of approximately ₹500 crore of Defence revenue in FY27. 
We are also setting up an ammunition manufacturing complex in the state of Andhra Pradesh. 
As I have already informed you that Government of AP has already allotted us 1000 acres of 
land parcel to set up this complex. Construction of this site will start soon. Together with the 
ongoing aerospace acquisition, will further strengthen our Defence and Aerospace platform. 
With a strong pipeline, expanding capabilities and increasing business visibility, we are 
confident that Defence and Aerospace can emerge as a substantially larger contributor to the 
Company’s growth in the coming years. 
Friends, let me close with conviction. We believe both optical fibre cable and connectivity 
solutions, Defence and Aerospace business are on the cusp of enormous growth. In Optical 
Fibre Cable, continuing demand, a strong order book and pipeline, and deeper backward 
integration support our confidence. In Defence, our capabilities, deliveries and strong pipeline 
are building the next leg of growth. 
We expect this growth momentum to continue. The opportunity we see extends over the next 
six to seven years and beyond. We are determined to convert it into sustained revenue growth, 
stronger profitability and lasting value for all our stakeholders.
